g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Date' for a time scale with values from Sunday, 15 January 1989, 12:00:00 AM to Friday, 15 January 2021, 12:00:00 AM
Y-axis titled 'Value_s' for a linear scale with values from −2 to 11
Symbol legend titled 'Index' for fill color and stroke color with 3 values: CPI, CPIH, RPI
